title: Quick Tip: BC28: What Is New in Document Reporting
summary: BC28 introduces enhanced document reporting features including an improved Word add-in with a redesigned data picker, a new table builder for layouts, lifecycle status management for user-defined layouts, company-level default document language, tooltips on reports, modernized report selection pages, and 36 new document APIs covering sales, purchasing, inventory, and assembly document types.
key_points: The Word add-in's data picker redesign makes field insertion easier with double-click capability, auto-advancing cursors in tables, cross-item search, and dark mode support.
Table Builder preview feature lets users configure and insert full table structures in one dialog, eliminating manual column-by-column field insertion.
Layouts can now have lifecycle states (Draft, Pending Approval, Approved, Retired) visible only to admins, controlling which layouts appear to users on report request pages.
Company-level default language code setting resolves document language based on customer card, then company default, then user UI language.
36 new APIs provide integration access to previously unavailable document types across sales, purchasing, inventory, and assembly without custom AL code.

quotes.text: The table builder compresses all of that into a single dialog.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates how the new feature significantly reduces the manual work required to build Word document layouts with complex table structures.
